status: prepared · not deployed · not funded · not executed
rpc: Tatum Sui Mainnet gRPC (every read, simulation and broadcast)

target_origin.note: A separate deployment (new Vercel project or local `next start`), never the Testnet demo at sisih-azure.vercel.app.

key_custody.owner: Local only (.env.mainnet on the owner's machine). Signs publish, create_vault, setup and every owner intent via pnpm sisih sign. Never on the server or Vercel.
key_custody.operator: Server (deployment env). Can only call release_to_agent through the OperatorCap, from free funds, within the agent's caps.
key_custody.agent: Server (deployment env): the x402 payer for released coins. The spending agent process (Claude Code) never holds it; it has only SISIH_AGENT_TOKEN.
key_custody.facilitator: Server (deployment env): co-signs x402 settlements as gas owner.
key_custody.note: Sisih is not fully non-custodial: the operator, agent and facilitator keys are held by the deployment. The owner key stays local, and the contract limits what the others can do.

operations.effects: package + UpgradeCap; IDs written to .env.mainnet.deployment (never .env or .env.mainnet)
shared Vault + OperatorCap to the operator

operations.what: setup: deposit 3.20 USDC, one commitment 1.00 USDC to the owner's own address, set_agent_policy 1.00 per request / 3.00 per day / 7 days
P1: ChainScope 0.80 held (new merchant) -> owner approves and remembers via pnpm sisih approve <id> --remember --yes (local signature)
operations.effects: release (operator) + x402 settle (facilitator) + decision and rule memories on Walrus Mainnet

operations.what: start_next_session (offchain, owner-signed): rules rebuilt from Walrus recall
P2: ChainScope 0.80 approved by the recalled preference

P3: ChainScope 0.80 refused: free 0.60 < 0.80 despite the allow preference (would_cut_reserve). Refused by the policy engine before any transaction; the contract boundary is shown by simulation only (labeled simulated), no gas spent.

merchant_recipient.note: Project-operated ChainScope address (MERCHANT_CHAINSCOPE_ADDRESS in .env.mainnet.deployment). Its proceeds are ours, recorded as returned funds, not revenue.

gas.method: Gross gas (computation + storage, rebates ignored). Computation is rescaled from Testnet measurements to the Mainnet reference gas price; storage is unchanged; publish is simulated on Mainnet. Per-role cap = 3x the gross estimates + the largest single gas budget that role sets (it must hold that budget when signing). Budgets are caps, not charges.

expected_receipts: P3 refusal (no transaction; simulation output labeled simulated)
Walrus job ids and blob ids (decision, rule, session summary)
decisions_required: Approve the funding request above (amounts and addresses).
Choose the Mainnet deployment origin (separate from the Testnet demo).
Confirm the project-operated ChainScope recipient address for Mainnet.
Confirm the Walrus Memory Mainnet proof namespace prefix (current: sisih-rehearsal).
